definitions.full: H6073. ophe עפאים Kt, עֳפָיִם Qr noun [masculine] plural foliage (compare Ges § 93z ; Aramaic loan-word, עָפְיָא ᵑ7 foliage , Syriac flower, branch ); — Psa 104:12 . עפא (√ of following; עֲפָא ᵑ7 Pa., Syriac Pa., enwrap , עֳפִי foliage , flower , etc., Biblical Hebrew עֳפָיִם עפאים, as loan-word; compare perhaps Assyrian upû , cloud (-mass)).
